item.title: Zellij 0.45.0: nested sessions, Kitty graphics, a fresh UI
item.description: var playerElement = document.getElementById("player-wrapper"); var player = new Clappr.Player({ source: "/video/version-045-intro.mp4", mute: false, height: 540, width: 960 }); player.attachTo(playerElement); Zellij 0.45.0 has just been released! Check it out! Some highlights: Nested Sessions Kitty Graphics Protocol Mobile Web UI New UI Scrolling by Command Per-Client Tab Sizes Focus Last Pane and Fullscreen Floating Panes Release Notes That Update Your Keybindings ADDENDUM: we’re building Zellij.online! Please Support the Zellij Developer ❤️ Nested Sessions Running Zellij inside Zellij has often been an awkward experience: doubled status bars, keybindings going to the wrong session and a lock mode dance to get anything done.
